title: Data Scientist, Algorithms Research
ai_summary: Analyze medical-device and clinical data to assess system behavior, performance, and clinical utility, and develop insights that support product improvements and research. Collaborate with engineering, clinical, software, and product teams; communicate findings through visualizations, reports, and technical documentation.

title: Senior Manager, Statistical Programming
ai_summary: Independently program and validate clinical trial data workflows from raw data through SDTM and ADaM datasets to safety and efficacy TFLs, with a focus on oncology studies and regulatory-ready deliverables. Lead development and maintenance of SAS and R automation tools, Shiny applications, and the R environment while overseeing vendor work and collaborating across clinical, statistical, regulatory, IT, and quality teams.

title: Biostatistician
ai_summary: Plan and conduct statistical analyses for clinical validation studies, product development, and real-world evidence projects, and prepare analysis plans, reports, regulatory materials, and publication-ready results. Collaborate with data, clinical, and regulatory teams to ensure data quality, communicate findings and limitations, and improve study design and analytical methods.

title: Senior Clinical Data Specialist
ai_summary: Lead clinical data management for assigned trials from study start-up through database lock, including EDC configuration and testing, documentation, data review, query management, reconciliation, and coding oversight. Coordinate CROs, vendors, and internal study teams; monitor deliverables and quality, support database freeze and lock, and maintain inspection-ready records.

title: Data Scientist, Truveta
ai_summary: Extract, develop, validate, and analyze complex healthcare datasets, especially from Truveta and Truveta Studio, and conduct rigorous statistical analyses for research projects. Collaborate with investigators and multidisciplinary teams, manage analytical deliverables across projects, and support publications, grants, presentations, and research trainees.

title: Data Entry - Clinical Research
ai_summary: Transcribe clinical research data accurately and promptly from source documents into electronic data capture systems, following ALCOA-C principles and applicable study requirements. Support source verification, data tracking, audit preparation, and coordination with clinical operations, quality, regulatory, and study teams.

title: Senior Clinical Data Manager
ai_summary: Develop, configure, test, and manage clinical trial databases and study-specific case report forms, documentation, edit checks, and data review processes. Coordinate with clinical teams, vendors, and medical scientists, provide study status and data insights, and train or mentor colleagues and study personnel.

title: Human Health Data Scientist/Radiation Epidemiologist
ai_summary: Design studies and synthesize and analyze morbidity and mortality data relevant to astronaut cohorts, while applying statistical expertise to develop radiation risk prediction tools for human spaceflight. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and communicate research findings through internal communications, conference presentations, and peer-reviewed publications.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Data Management
ai_summary: Lead data management for two oncology clinical trials, serving as the primary contact and overseeing data activities through database lock and archiving. Review and reconcile data, manage database updates and testing, monitor quality and metrics, maintain study documentation, and ensure regulatory compliance while coordinating with vendors and cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Principal Statistician
ai_summary: Design, analyze, and report clinical trial results, including developing statistical methods and plans, programming and validating datasets and submission deliverables, and supporting regulatory submissions. Oversee statistical programming resources and vendor work, collaborate across clinical and data management teams, and maintain compliant processes while mentoring and managing personnel.

title: Director, Pharmacovigilance Scientist
ai_summary: Lead strategic and operational pharmacovigilance for assigned development programs, including signal management, safety data review, aggregate reporting, risk management, and safety input into clinical and regulatory documents. Coordinate cross-functional safety teams, oversee CROs and vendors, support regulatory interactions and inspection readiness, and mentor staff while improving PV processes.

title: Senior Scientist — Regulatory Cardiac Safety/Electrophysiology (Scientist II)

Provides technical client consultation, supports proposals and pricing, guides laboratory operations, and trains and mentors staff.

title: Data Reviewer/ Associate Scientist
ai_summary: Review data and documentation for GMP testing, stability studies, and analytical and formulation development projects, ensuring calculations and records are accurate and compliant with internal procedures and cGMP standards. Provide detailed feedback on corrections, maintain knowledge of relevant technologies, and work with functional management to improve review processes and cycle times.

title: Director, Pharmacovigilance (PV) Operations
ai_summary: Lead global pharmacovigilance operations across clinical development, expanded access, and commercial products, including vendor oversight, safety systems, aggregate reporting, compliance, and inspection readiness. Establish scalable processes and governance, partner with cross-functional teams and external organizations, and drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.

title: Senior Scientist I, Biostatistics
ai_summary: Provide statistical and biostatistical expertise for product development and scientific programs, including study design, data analysis, interpretation, and communication of findings. Partner with internal teams and external collaborators to translate scientific evidence and field observations into product decisions and improvements.

title: Medical Director, Global Drug Safety
ai_summary: Provide medical safety oversight for assigned products across clinical development and post-approval, including case review, signal detection, benefit-risk assessment, and safety reporting. Lead or contribute to cross-functional safety teams, clinical study activities, regulatory documents, audits, and risk management initiatives.

title: Clinical Laboratory Scientist - Data Review
ai_summary: Reviews and validates chromatographic data and calculated results from urine drug tests using LC-MS-MS and EIA, troubleshoots testing issues, and maintains quality control and required records. Approves and reports results to physicians, supports laboratory staff, and contributes to audits and safe laboratory operations.

title: Associate, Clinical Data (Remote)

title: Sr. Director, Biostatistics
ai_summary: Lead statistical strategy and execution across clinical development programs, including study design, analyses, data interpretation, regulatory submissions, and health authority interactions. Advise cross-functional teams, oversee external biostatistics and programming partners, and establish statistical standards while balancing strategic leadership with hands-on work.

title: Senior Principal Biostatistician
ai_summary: Lead statistical activities for one or more clinical studies, including authoring and reviewing study documents, developing TLF specifications, and contributing to analyses and study reporting. Collaborate with cross-functional teams on study design, statistical and data-related issues, external interactions, and clear communication of statistical considerations.

title: Principal, Biostatistician
ai_summary: Leads assigned biostatistics projects, ensuring deliverables meet agreed timelines and quality standards while coordinating technical communication with clients and internal teams. Develops and reviews statistical plans, analyses, reports, and clinical trial materials; supports monitoring committees, training, audits, project planning, and the development of other biostatisticians.

title: Associate Director, Clinical Data Management
ai_summary: Lead clinical data management strategy and end-to-end data operations for assigned global clinical programs, including study start-up, database development, data review, vendor oversight, and timely database lock. Ensure data quality, regulatory compliance, inspection readiness, and alignment of collected data with statistical analyses, TLF outputs, and clinical study reports.

ai_summary: Develop and maintain Python-based large-language-model research tools for cybersecurity data, including deep learning applications, unit tests, and continuous integration pipelines. Collaborate on software development, documentation, code reviews, cybersecurity research, and proposals for external and internal funding.

Communicate findings and limitations, contribute to scientific publications and presentations, and provide technical guidance to junior analysts and collaborators.

title: Senior Director, Biostatistics

Guide trial design, analyses, regulatory submissions, and study documentation, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to support sound clinical decisions and high-quality data.

title: Senior Statistical Programmer
ai_summary: Develop and deliver clinical trial programming outputs, including SDTM and ADaM datasets, Define.XML files, Reviewer’s Guides, annotated case report forms, and tables, figures, and listings. Review statistical analysis plans, develop programming tools and macros, validate other programmers’ outputs, and collaborate with cross-functional teams.

title: Director, Biostatistics
ai_summary: Lead statistical activities and strategies for oncology programs, including study design, analysis, reporting, and evidence generation. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and external vendors, oversee statistical deliverables and quality, and support publications and presentations.
